rationale: Curated list of programmatic-SEO sites that are demonstrably winning in production. The engine's verdict on each must be at or below `expectedVerdictCeiling` — anything worse is a calibration failure on our side, not the site. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-03-calibration-against-reputable-pseo.md.

groundTruth.evidence: Zapier's app/integration directory is the canonical pSEO success — 5,000+ heavily-templated pages, ranks #1 for 'X zapier integration' across major SaaS apps, surviving every Helpful Content System rebuild since 2022.
G2 categories rank top-3 for nearly every 'best X software' query. Heavily templated, hundreds of category pages.

Wise's currency-converter directory ranks #1 for thousands of 'X to Y exchange rate' queries — programmatic finance pages with strong primary-source data (live rates). 2026-05-06 ceiling raised caution→concerning: the v0.5.12 pinned URL set captures locale-hub pages (wise.com/au/, wise.com/de/, etc.) rather than actual /from-to currency-pair leaf pages. These hub pages share near-identical title tags and meta descriptions across locales, correctly triggering content/title-uniqueness and content/meta-uniqueness at error severity — both are real SEO signals on this URL set, not engine mis-calibration. The original caution ceiling was set against stochastic sampling that happened to hit currency-pair leaf pages; the pinned set exposes a real structural issue in the locale hub layer.
NerdWallet's comparison directories are the dominant US finance-comparison destination.

Webflow templates directory ranks for 'webflow template X' queries; visually distinct per-page (preview thumbnails). Note: 2026-05-03 calibration round 4 showed `caution` is the appropriate ceiling — template gallery cards have ~150 words each and no per-template authors by design (the visual preview IS the content), so AEO/EEAT rules surface cosmetic findings even at info severity.
Typeform's templates directory ranks for 'X form template' queries; mid-corpus pSEO.
B2B data-integration pSEO that ranks for 'segment X integration' across hundreds of source/destination pairs.
Modern AI-product pSEO; templates directory ranks for 'AI X writer'/'AI X generator' queries.
B2B fintech pSEO; category and use-case pages ranking for spend-management queries.
Numbeo is the long-running canonical cost-of-living-by-city pSEO directory; thousands of city pages, all ranking.
Open-source data-integration pSEO; connectors directory ranks for 'X to Y data sync' queries.
Stripe Atlas state-by-state guides — programmatic legal-info content with Stripe-grade editorial polish.
Own dogfood site; ~5,600 templated role×document×state pages, no E-E-A-T, YMYL (legal). Tracked subject — no pass/fail expectation.

Live; templated "[Name] Height, Weight, Age, Facts, Biography" pages at scale; flagged in Originality.ai March-2024 AI-prevalence study set. https://originality.ai/blog/google-march-2024-manual-action-ai-update-list
Live; footer densely stuffed with Sarkari Naukri / Government Jobs / 2025-2026 keyword variants; templated category/job pages at scale (keyword-stuffing density example).

excluded.reason: Sites that actively rate-limit or CAPTCHA non-residential crawlers, returning 403/429 instead of audit-ready HTML. Adding them now would pollute the corpus with fetch errors rather than calibration data.
